label.text: Your email accounts: add Gmail, Outlook.com, your own domain or a shared team address; sign-in, servers, sync and members.
The name and address people see on your mail, where their replies go, and your signatures.
Sort mail as it arrives: into folders, with labels, flagged, forwarded or out of the Inbox; and the senders you blocked.
An automatic reply while you are away, with a different one for people inside the organization.
Text you write often, one click or a / and a shortcut away in a message; yours or shared with a group.
Notifications, sounds, Enter to send, message previews and when you show as away.
Your numbers and your voicemail: greeting, PIN, email notices and how many rings before it answers.
A desk phone or a phone app that rings with your calls, with voicemail after it as set in Phone, and calls out as you; its password is shown once.
